command:
cat > /tmp/lcl-dashboard-prompt.txt <<'EOF'
Work ONLY in this repository and current branch. Read AGENTS.md first and obey it. This is a UI-only Dashboard polish pass for Local Climate Link. Do NOT alter Shelly/BLE/automation-core semantics, persistence, networking, safety logic, or unrelated architecture. Reuse existing runtime-control hooks and components. Keep the diff small, typed, testable, token-based, and avoid one-off hacks.

Accepted user visual target: compact calm native smart-home dashboard. Top heading on one row; refresh/settings equal compact icon actions aligned at right; no filler subtitle/kicker; compact climate/time selector; short dense automation cards; temperature primary, humidity secondary; visible ON/OFF and Auto/Manual controls; minimal borders/shadows; no decorative filler; useful information retained unless explicitly removed.

Required fixes now:
1. Remove dashboard description equivalent to 'Podgląd tego, co aktualnie widzi i robi każde Shelly.' and redundant kicker if it only adds height.
2. Fix settings/refresh asymmetry and global settings action pushing content down. Use the smallest coherent shared header/shell solution.
3. Make climate cards substantially shorter while preserving useful data and touch targets.
4. Restore visible ON/OFF and Manual/Auto controls on climate cards using the exact existing runtime-control semantics already used elsewhere. Do not invent behavior. Pending/disabled/error states must remain safe.
5. After deleting the last automation, route directly to existing 'Co chcesz zrobić?' intent screen. Zero-installation startup and post-delete converge there; remove redundant empty Dashboard route/state if appropriate.
6. Keep time cards visually coherent without changing schedule behavior.
7. Use existing design tokens/shared primitives; no hardcoded theme colors.

Inspect AutomationDashboardScreen, TimeAutomationCard, App/App shell, AppRoutes, InstallationDetail/TimeInstallationDetail, current runtime control hooks and relevant tests before editing. Add/update focused tests for zero-state routing and dashboard controls where practical. Do not commit/push; leave changes in working tree.
EOF
codex exec -s workspace-write -C . "$(cat /tmp/lcl-dashboard-prompt.txt)"; test -n "$(git status --porcelain apps/mobile)"; echo APP_DIFF_PRESENT; git diff --check -- apps/mobile
